title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 4: Clown Loach
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ４ ～クラウン・ローチ～
overview:
The AQUAZONE world expands even further with new fish, water plants, accessories and background images!

This is the fourth option disc for Aquazone, the tropical fish tank simulator. It brings clown loaches to raise in your virtual aquarium, along with new plants, ornaments and scenery for the tank.

- New fish: clown loach
- New water plant: kouhone (Japanese pond lily)
- New accessories: a small sandstone rock, Orinoco River driftwood, a kayak and an unexploded shell
- Six new background images
- Requires the Aquazone Sega Saturn disc

新しい魚、水草、アクセサリー、背景画によってさらに拡がるAQUAZONEワールド!
